evidence.windows_visible_error: IOException on runtime MT5_B/config/servers.dat: file is being used by another process

root_cause: MaterializeRuntimeClone created destination with FileShare.None using a using-var whose lifetime extended through the subsequent HashFile(dest) parity read. RunnerLab therefore attempted to reopen its own exclusively-held destination before disposal.
correction: scope source and destination FileStreams in explicit using blocks
dispose exclusive destination before SHA-256 parity reopen
add native self-test requiring immediate exclusive reopen after copy+parity
scientific_impact: No MVP2B runtime launch result was produced; failure occurred before MT5 launch. MVP2A PASS remains valid.
next_gate: Rebuild and rerun MVP2B; D20 self-test must PASS before any real isolated MT5 launch.
